generality.description: Separate Colab run of 144 unguarded answers (hidden states stored). Tests whether the failure direction is shared across secrets or depends on the secret.
generality.caveats: Only 23 testable leaks, 1-7 per secret. The fitted direction won on 6 of 8 secrets; the original on 2. The test leaves out the secret only: same system prompt and attack wording, one model, one layer. Random directions in 2048 dimensions have cosine about 0.02.
